title: Central Japan with Mount Fuji Group Tour
alt: Lake Kawaguchi with Mount Fuji behind it, Japan

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large four star hotel beside Shinagawa station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights beside Shinagawa station, with free time in Shinjuku and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Kawaguchiko
stops.subtitle: Kawaguchiko to Mount Fuji
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Lakeside resort with Mount Fuji across the water on a clear day

activities.name: Arakurayama Sengen park and shrine
activities.description: The four hundred steps up to the Chureito pagoda, where the pagoda, the cherry trees and Mount Fuji line up in one frame.

activities.name: Lake Kawaguchi boat ride
activities.description: A cruise out onto the lake, with the mountain reflected in the water when the cloud lifts.

activities.name: Mount Fuji fifth station
activities.description: Up the mountain road to the fifth station at 2,300 metres, where the treeline ends and the climbing trail begins.

program.name: Kawaguchiko
program.description: A lakeside night below Mount Fuji, with the Chureito pagoda, a boat ride and the drive up to the fifth station.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.subtitle: Kyoto to Nagoya and Osaka
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel opposite Kyoto station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Iyashi no Sato Nenba village
activities.description: A rebuilt village of thatched farmhouses below Mount Fuji, now craft workshops where you can try dyeing or pottery.

activities.name: Shiraito falls
activities.description: A two hundred metre curtain of spring water falling in white threads, fed by the snowmelt off Mount Fuji.

activities.name: Toyota automobile museum
activities.description: The museum in Nagoya that runs from the first looms through to the cars, with machines you can watch working.

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the old capital, taking in the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths above Fushimi.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: Two nights by Kyoto station, reached through the Fuji foothills and Nagoya, with a guided day and a free evening in Gion.

day_titles.4: Shiraito falls and on to Kyoto

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Free time in the Shinjuku district
2: Breakfast, then a guided day through Tokyo
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast and check out, then west towards Mount Fuji
The Chureito pagoda at Arakurayama Sengen park
A boat ride out onto Lake Kawaguchi
Up the mountain road to the fifth station
4: Breakfast, then the thatched village of Iyashi no Sato
Shiraito falls, fed by the snowmelt off Fuji
The Toyota automobile museum in Nagoya
On to Kyoto and check in by the station
5: Breakfast, then a guided day through the old capital
The golden pavilion and a Zen garden
The torii gate paths above Fushimi
Free time in the Gion lanes in the evening
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Transfer to Osaka and Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Six days with eight guided experiences in them. For a first look at central Japan, nothing is wasted.
expert.tip: Sleeping at Kawaguchiko gives you two chances at a clear mountain, evening and morning. Day trippers only get one.

summary: Six days on a small group tour: Tokyo with a guided city day, a lakeside night below Mount Fuji with the Chureito pagoda, a boat ride and the fifth station, then two nights in Kyoto reached through Shiraito falls and Nagoya.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; coach travel and guided touring throughout; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Arakurayama Sengen park and shrine; Lake Kawaguchi boat ride; Mount Fuji fifth station; Iyashi no Sato Nenba; Shiraito falls; Toyota automobile museum tickets; Kyoto sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
